Name: Moza, Son of Zimri
Summary: Son of Zimri and father of Binea.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:36; 1 Chronicles 9:42: Son of Zimri and father of Binea.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Moza stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
